title: Coupling
description: ThreeLegCoupling attestation refs (spec §4.1). Source of truth: EPR atom, self-notarized via content-address (CIDv1 dag-cbor sha256) + Ed25519 signature. Canonical CBOR bytes + detached signature is the authoritative form. Category A — notarized; notarization mechanism is content-derived CID + signer proof (not DHT). JSON wire format: CID fields serialize as integer arrays when present; fields are absent (not null) when not set, because Rust uses skip_serializing_if on Option fields.

knowledge.description: CIDv1 of Claim-EPR binding to knowledge graph, serialized as a byte array. Absent when not set.

value.description: CIDv1 of EconomicEvent-EPR, serialized as a byte array. Absent when not set.

governance.description: CIDv1 of Governance-EPR, serialized as a byte array. Absent when not set.
